_comment: What Merit buys at the guild counter. Rank index 0..5 = E..S. 'form' editor IDs are resolved by tools/EspGen against the vanilla masters (a typo fails the build).
_library: Guild Library: for each skill, the next vanilla skill book the player hasn't read. Book N (1-5) needs rank N-1 and costs meritByTier[N-1].
_tomes: Spell tomes useful to any adventurer, regardless of school. A tome is offered at its rank and below. tomesAboveRank: tomes up to 'ranks' above your own are offered too, at 'multiplier' times the Merit; anything higher is not shown. ranks 0 = only your rank and below.
_supplies: Potions, bought one at a time.
_training: Guild Training: a permanent +amount to max Health / Stamina / Magicka per purchase, at most perRank purchases per stat for each guild rank reached (E = perRank, D = 2*perRank ...). The first purchase costs baseMerit; each one after costs more than the last by the stepMerit of the rank it belongs to (index 0..5 = E..S; a single number means the same step throughout): 40, 60 at E; 80, 100 at D; 130, 160 at C; 190, 220 at B; 260, 300 at A; 340, 380 at S. Max purchases per stat = perRank*6 (the ESP carries that many steps).
_augments: Guild Augments: a timed boon bought at the counter, one at a time (a new one replaces the one you have). merit: the price of each. rank: the guild rank they need. days: how long one lasts, in game days. list: at most 8; the ESP carries one ability each, built by tools/EspGen from the numbers here (carry: carry weight; barter: percent better prices; skillRate: percent faster skill gains; resistDisease / resistPoison: percent; health / stamina / magicka: points). name and desc are the English text (translators: $AG_Aug_<id>, $AG_AugDesc_<id>).
